title: Air Quality Model Runs
description: NASA utilizes satellite instruments and models to monitor sources of air pollutants and their movement through the atmosphere. This visualization shows concentrations of air pollutants, such as Particulate Matter (PM2.5, fine particles smaller than 2.5 micrometers), Ozone (O~3~), Carbon Monoxide (CO), and Nitrogen Oxides (NO~x~) as they are tracked from NASA's Goddard Earth Observing System Composition Forecasting (GEOS-CF) system.

Technical support: Ella Kaplan (Global Science and Technology, Inc.)

datasets.name: GEOS-CF
datasets.description: Knowland, K.E., C.A. Keller, and R. Lucchesi, 2022: File Specification for GEOS-CF Products. GMAO Office Note No. 17 (Version 1.3), 54 pp, available from [https://gmao.gsfc.nasa.gov/pubs/docs/Knowland1446.pdf](https://gmao.gsfc.nasa.gov/pubs/docs/Knowland1446.pdf)

credit_line: Visualization: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio (SVS 5533, 5518) for the NASA Earth Information Center. Data: NASA GEOS-CF (GMAO), model output.
disclosure: Values read from the EIC frames' colours with each species' colorbar: a model run, not measurements.
licence: SVS: "All of our content is in the public domain (unless otherwise noted), meaning that it is free to download, use, and redistribute for whatever purposes you see fit." (https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/help/, read 29 Oct 2026)
